title: galium bungei
intro: Galium bungei, commonly known as Chinese galium or Chinese gentian, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to improve digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Galium bungei include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs, colds, and flu. The bioactive constituents of Galium bungei include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
